verdict.rationale: The evidence documents REST endpoints in human-readable pages (e.g., POST /acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/tokens), an llms.txt index, an MCP server, and a public Trusted Agent Protocol spec. None of these is a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API description, so they are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit. An API product could plausibly ship such a spec, so the axis applies, but the pack has no evidence of one.
